name: original-subject-windows
source:
import re
cases=[('^b','ab',1,2),('(?<=a)b','ab',1,2),('b$','abc',1,2),('(?m)^b','a\nb',2,3),('(?<=(é))😀','é😀尾',1,2),('b(?=c)','abc',1,2),('','a',10,10),(r'\b','aX',1,1),('\x00','a\x00b',1,2),('(?<=é)x','éxy',2,3),('a','ab',-5,100)]
for pattern,text,pos,end in cases:
 p=re.compile(pattern)
 for op in [p.search,p.match,p.fullmatch]:
  m=op(text,pos,end)
  print(None if m is None else (m.span(),m.groups(),m.string,m.pos,m.endpos))

name: window-cursor-captures-and-empty-progression
source:

for pattern,text,pos,end in [('(?<=(a))b|(?<=b)','abc',1,2),('.*?','é😀尾',1,2),('^b','ab',1,2),('(?m)^b','a\nbc',2,3),('','a',2,0)]:
 p=re.compile(pattern)
 print(p.findall(text,pos,end))
 for m in p.finditer(text,pos,end):
  print(m.span(),m.groups(),m.pos,m.endpos)
